source: UX Magazine data visualization playbook (23 chart families), extended with dashboard forms from the dataviz skill and Mobbin research. Rendered into references/chart-catalog.md by scripts/build-reference.mjs.
description: Every chart form the skill knows, one entry per form: what job it does, when to use it, when to avoid it, whether the baseline must be zero, limits, which color job it takes, which audience it suits, how well it fits web-app dashboards ('core' = default toolkit, 'situational' = good for a specific job, 'rare' = specialist, needs an analyst audience and a how-to-read note), and how to build it in the Vois stack (shadcn Chart over Recharts). `recharts` is a build hint, not a mandate: check the workspace manifest. `article_ref` is the section number in the source playbook where one exists.

fields.color_job: categorical | ordinal | sequential | diverging | status | single | none

forms.name: Stat tile
forms.job: Show one current value with its change
forms.use_when: One headline number; a KPI row of 3 to 6 numbers; the number is the answer.
forms.avoid_when: You need to see shape over time (add a sparkline) or compare many categories.
forms.limits: Label, value, delta vs a named period, optional 12-point sparkline. One hero per view at 48px or more.
forms.recharts: Card with a value and an optional tiny AreaChart or LineChart with no axes; not a chart library job.
forms.a11y: Value, delta and period are real text. The arrow and sign carry direction, not just color.

forms.name: Meter or progress bar
forms.job: Show one ratio against a limit
forms.use_when: Quota used, goal progress, capacity.
forms.avoid_when: Two-slice pie; more than one measure (use a bullet graph).
forms.limits: Fill carries severity (accent, warning, danger); the unfilled track is a lighter step of the same ramp.
forms.recharts: Progress component, or RadialBarChart for a ring.
forms.a11y: role progressbar or meter with aria-valuenow, valuemin, valuemax and a text value.

forms.name: Sparkline
forms.job: Trend at a glance inside a table row or tile
forms.use_when: Tables and stat tiles where the number matters and the trend is context.
forms.avoid_when: The reader needs exact values or to compare across rows precisely.
forms.limits: No axes or grid. Muted line, accent end-dot. About 12 to 30 points. Links to the full chart.
forms.recharts: Tiny LineChart or AreaChart in a fixed-height cell, no axes, no tooltip unless on hover.
forms.a11y: aria-hidden when the adjacent value and delta carry the meaning, else a text summary.

forms.name: Table (with pivot variant)
forms.job: Look up exact values or compare many attributes
forms.use_when: Exact lookup, many columns, more than about 7 meaningful classes, or the table twin of any chart. Pivot tables let analysts regroup rows, columns and values.
forms.avoid_when: The reader needs the shape, not the numbers.
forms.limits: Right-align numbers, tabular-nums, sort and search past about 25 rows, sticky header. Inline bars or sparklines are welcome.
forms.recharts: Table or DataTable (see vois-components JOB-DISPLAY-DATA).
forms.a11y: Real table semantics: th scope, caption.

forms.name: Column chart (vertical bar)
forms.job: Compare values across a few categories or discrete periods
forms.use_when: Up to about 12 categories with short labels, or a natural order such as months.
forms.avoid_when: Long labels, rankings of many items (use horizontal), a continuous trend (use a line).
forms.limits: Bars at most 24px thick, 4px rounded data end, 2px gap. Value on the cap when labels fit.
forms.recharts: BarChart, Bar radius top, CartesianGrid vertical false.
forms.a11y: Per-bar tooltip on hover and focus; table view.

forms.name: Bar chart (horizontal)
forms.job: Rank or compare categories with long labels
forms.use_when: Top N lists, long category names, 6 to 25 items.
forms.avoid_when: Time series.
forms.limits: Sort descending unless ordered. Label at the bar end. Top 10 plus Other.
forms.recharts: BarChart layout='vertical' with XAxis type number and YAxis type category.
forms.a11y: Labels are real text; tooltip on focus; table view.

forms.name: Grouped bar chart
forms.job: Compare 2 to 3 series within each category
forms.use_when: This year vs last year per quarter; a handful of categories.
forms.avoid_when: More than 3 series per group or more than about 6 groups.
forms.limits: Up to 3 series. Legend required.
forms.recharts: BarChart with several Bar and no stackId.
forms.a11y: Legend plus tooltip listing all series; table view.

forms.name: Stacked bar chart
forms.job: Show a total and its parts
forms.use_when: Totals matter and there are 5 or fewer parts, such as sales by region per quarter.
forms.avoid_when: Reading exact middle segments is the task (only the baseline segment shares an origin).
forms.limits: 5 or fewer segments, 2px surface gaps, order matches legend. Label only segments that fit.
forms.recharts: BarChart with Bar stackId.
forms.a11y: Tooltip lists every segment; table view.

forms.name: 100% stacked bar
forms.job: Compare shares of a whole across groups
forms.use_when: Shares matter, totals don't.
forms.avoid_when: Totals matter; more than 5 parts.
forms.limits: Axis 0 to 100 percent. Show totals in the table.
forms.recharts: BarChart with Bar stackId and stackOffset expand.
forms.a11y: Tooltip shows the percent and the count.

forms.name: Diverging (positive and negative) bar
forms.job: Show performance above or below a baseline
forms.use_when: Variance to target, profit and loss, sentiment, change vs last period.
forms.avoid_when: All values are the same sign.
forms.limits: Centered on the baseline. Two opposing hues or one accent plus gray. Never red and green alone.
forms.recharts: BarChart with negative values, ReferenceLine y 0, Cell fill by sign.
forms.a11y: Sign in the label and tooltip; color is a second channel.

forms.name: Diverging stacked bar
forms.job: Show shares on an ordered scale such as Likert
forms.use_when: Strongly disagree to strongly agree.
forms.avoid_when: Unordered categories.
forms.limits: Centered on the neutral midpoint. Ordered ramp from one pole to the other.
forms.recharts: BarChart layout vertical with offset stacks (custom data shift).
forms.a11y: Labels at the bar ends and in the table view.

forms.name: Waterfall chart
forms.job: Show how increases and decreases build to a total
forms.use_when: Revenue to profit bridges, cash movement, variance explanations.
forms.avoid_when: No running total.
forms.limits: Start, steps, end. Increase and decrease use a status or diverging pair plus sign labels.
forms.recharts: BarChart with a transparent offset Bar and a visible delta Bar.
forms.a11y: Sign and value in the label, table view with step and running total.

forms.name: Pareto chart
forms.job: Prioritize the vital few causes
forms.use_when: Issue triage where about 20 percent of causes drive 80 percent of effects.
forms.avoid_when: No cumulative question.
forms.limits: Bars descending, cumulative-percent line. The right scale is fixed at 0 to 100 percent, labeled, and is the only sanctioned two-scale chart (see DV-HONEST-002). Mark it with a dataviz-allow comment. If in doubt, show cumulative percent as a table column.
forms.recharts: ComposedChart with Bar and Line.
forms.a11y: Table view with cumulative percent.

forms.name: Dumbbell (before and after)
forms.job: Show change per item between two states
forms.use_when: Before and after per team, this year vs last per region.
forms.avoid_when: More than about 15 items or more than two states.
forms.limits: Two dots joined by a line, one hue in two shades. Sorted by change.
forms.recharts: Custom SVG or ScatterChart with ErrorBar.
forms.a11y: Table view with both values and the delta.

forms.name: Bullet graph
forms.job: Compare actual to target across several metrics
forms.use_when: Scorecards: actual, target and poor, average, good bands in a compact bar.
forms.avoid_when: One metric (use a meter).
forms.limits: Actual bar, target tick, 3 muted bands from one ramp. Include a text value.
forms.recharts: Custom SVG, or stacked Bar plus ReferenceLine.
forms.a11y: Text for actual, target and status.

forms.name: Line chart
forms.job: Show a trend over time for one series
forms.use_when: Continuous time series, rate of change matters, many points.
forms.avoid_when: Few discrete periods whose magnitudes matter (columns); parts of a whole.
forms.limits: 2px line, linear or monotone, end-dot of at least 8px, solid hairline grid. State a non-zero axis.
forms.recharts: LineChart, Line type monotone, dot false, activeDot.
forms.a11y: Crosshair tooltip on hover and focus; table view; accessibilityLayer.

forms.name: Multi-line chart
forms.job: Compare 2 to 4 series over time on one scale
forms.use_when: Same unit, same scale, 2 to 4 series, optionally the previous period as a muted dotted line.
forms.avoid_when: Different scales (never dual axis); more than 5 series (emphasis or small multiples).
forms.limits: Legend always, direct end-labels for up to 4. One tooltip listing all series.
forms.recharts: LineChart with several Line, ChartLegend, shared ChartTooltip.
forms.a11y: Legend as buttons, tooltip on focus, table view.

forms.name: Step line
forms.job: Show a value that holds between events
forms.use_when: Plan tier, stock level, provisioned resources, cumulative options.
forms.avoid_when: Continuous measurements.
forms.limits: Line type step or stepAfter.
forms.recharts: Line type stepAfter.
forms.a11y: Tooltip at each change; table view.

forms.name: Area chart
forms.job: Show cumulative volume over time for one series
forms.use_when: Volume is the message and zero is meaningful.
forms.avoid_when: Several overlapping series.
forms.limits: Fill is the series hue at about 10 percent; the edge is a 2px line.
forms.recharts: AreaChart, Area type monotone, fillOpacity about 0.1.
forms.a11y: Same as line.

forms.name: Stacked area chart
forms.job: Show a total and its parts over many periods
forms.use_when: Parts of a whole across many time points; totals matter; 5 or fewer parts.
forms.avoid_when: Reading an inner part's trend precisely; more than 5 parts.
forms.limits: Order so the most important part sits at the baseline.
forms.recharts: AreaChart with Area stackId.
forms.a11y: Tooltip lists all; table view.

forms.name: 100% stacked area
forms.job: Show how shares change over time
forms.use_when: Mix shifts matter, totals don't.
forms.avoid_when: Totals matter.
forms.limits: Axis 0 to 100 percent.
forms.recharts: AreaChart with stackOffset expand.
forms.a11y: Tooltip shows percent and count.

forms.name: Positive and negative area
forms.job: Show above and below a baseline over time
forms.use_when: Net flows, variance to a target over time.
forms.avoid_when: All values are the same sign.
forms.limits: Centered on zero, two opposing hues.
forms.recharts: AreaChart with split gradient at 0.
forms.a11y: Sign in the tooltip.

forms.name: Candlestick or OHLC
forms.job: Show open, high, low and close per session
forms.use_when: Prices for stocks, commodities, currencies.
forms.avoid_when: Anything that is not OHLC data.
forms.limits: Net gain and loss use a diverging pair plus fill versus hollow.
forms.recharts: ComposedChart with custom shape.
forms.a11y: Tooltip with O, H, L, C; table view.

forms.name: Small multiples
forms.job: Compare many series or measures without a second axis
forms.use_when: Different scales, more than about 5 series, or a 9th series.
forms.avoid_when: Two series that share a scale (use a multi-line).
forms.limits: Same chart repeated, shared scales or stated otherwise, shared crosshair, one legend.
forms.recharts: One ChartContainer per panel in a CSS grid.
forms.a11y: Each panel has a title and a text alternative.

forms.name: Emphasis (one accent, rest gray)
forms.job: Make one series the story among many
forms.use_when: The title names one series and the rest are context.
forms.avoid_when: Every series is the point.
forms.limits: One accent hue, de-emphasis gray for the rest. Label the accent series.
forms.recharts: Line or Bar with per-series stroke from tokens.
forms.a11y: Direct label on the accent series; table view.

forms.name: Donut chart
forms.job: Part-to-whole glance with a total
forms.use_when: 3 to 6 segments that sum to 100 percent, with the total in the hole.
forms.avoid_when: Comparing close values; more than 6 segments; more than one whole.
forms.limits: Sort descending from 12 o'clock. Values in the legend.
forms.recharts: PieChart, Pie innerRadius, Label in the center.
forms.a11y: Legend with values; table view.

forms.name: Pie chart
forms.job: Part-to-whole glance
forms.use_when: 3 to 6 segments when the donut hole is not needed.
forms.avoid_when: Close values; more than 6 segments; 2 segments (use a stat).
forms.limits: Prefer the donut.
forms.recharts: PieChart, Pie.
forms.a11y: As donut.

forms.name: Waffle or square chart
forms.job: Read a share in single percentage points
forms.use_when: A 10 by 10 grid where each square is 1 percent.
forms.avoid_when: Many categories.
forms.limits: 100 cells, 1 to 4 categories, one hue ramp or categorical.
forms.recharts: Custom grid of divs or SVG rects.
forms.a11y: Text value and legend; table view.

forms.name: Treemap
forms.job: Show proportion within nested categories
forms.use_when: Many items with a hierarchy and a size measure, such as a portfolio by sector.
forms.avoid_when: Precise comparison; more than 2 levels.
forms.limits: Size is the measure, color is a second measure on a sequential or diverging ramp with a scale key.
forms.recharts: Treemap.
forms.a11y: Labels inside tiles when they fit; table view.

forms.name: Sunburst
forms.job: Show proportion within nested rings
forms.use_when: Budget allocation or navigation paths with 2 to 4 levels.
forms.avoid_when: General audience.
forms.limits: Concentric rings, one per level.
forms.recharts: Custom SVG or d3.
forms.a11y: Table view with path.

forms.name: Tree layout
forms.job: Show structure and parent-child relationships
forms.use_when: Org charts, file trees, genealogy.
forms.avoid_when: You need proportion.
forms.limits: Nodes and edges; color for team or type.
forms.recharts: Custom, or a nested list with expand.
forms.a11y: Use tree semantics (role tree) or nested lists.

forms.name: Radar or radial chart
forms.job: Profile an entity across 5 or more dimensions
forms.use_when: Skill mapping, performance evaluation for 1 to 3 entities on the same scale.
forms.avoid_when: General audiences; precise comparison; unordered axes where area misleads.
forms.limits: Same scale on every axis, 6 axes or fewer for readability, 3 series or fewer.
forms.recharts: RadarChart, RadialBarChart.
forms.a11y: Table view with every axis value.

forms.name: Histogram
forms.job: Show how often values fall in ranges
forms.use_when: Duration, latency or amount distributions for a general audience.
forms.avoid_when: Categories (use a bar chart).
forms.limits: Equal-width adjacent bars, a stated bucket size, annotate modes.
forms.recharts: BarChart with barCategoryGap 0 on pre-bucketed data.
forms.a11y: Table view of bucket and count.

forms.name: Box plot
forms.job: Compare spread across groups
forms.use_when: Min, quartiles, median, max across groups or periods; outliers matter.
forms.avoid_when: General audience without a legend explaining the box.
forms.limits: Five-number summary, outlier dots, a one-line how-to-read.
forms.recharts: ComposedChart with custom shape.
forms.a11y: Table view with five numbers per group.

forms.name: Violin plot
forms.job: Show distribution shape and density per group
forms.use_when: Analyst comparing multimodal distributions.
forms.avoid_when: Anyone unfamiliar; use a histogram or box plot.
forms.limits: Outer shape is density, inner marks are quartiles and the median.
forms.recharts: Custom SVG or d3.
forms.a11y: Table view.

forms.name: KDE (density) plot
forms.job: Show a smooth distribution to compare several
forms.use_when: Comparing 2 to 3 distributions without binning artifacts.
forms.avoid_when: General audience; small samples where the smooth curve implies more than the data supports.
forms.limits: 3 curves or fewer, state the bandwidth.
forms.recharts: AreaChart on precomputed density.
forms.a11y: Table view.

forms.name: Scatter plot
forms.job: Show correlation and outliers between two measures
forms.use_when: Two numeric measures across many items.
forms.avoid_when: One point over time (line).
forms.limits: 3 series or fewer when grouped (all pairs can be neighbors). Hit areas of at least 24px or a nearest-point layer.
forms.recharts: ScatterChart.
forms.a11y: Table view; nearest-point keyboard navigation.

forms.name: Bubble chart
forms.job: Show a third measure as size on a scatter
forms.use_when: Three numeric measures where size is meaningful.
forms.avoid_when: Size differences are small or precise.
forms.limits: Size by area, not radius. Cap overlap, use transparency.
forms.recharts: ScatterChart with ZAxis.
forms.a11y: Table view.

forms.name: Pairplot
forms.job: Find correlations across many variables
forms.use_when: Data scientists screening 4 to 6 variables.
forms.avoid_when: Dashboards for a business audience.
forms.limits: Grid of scatters off the diagonal, distributions on it.
forms.recharts: Custom grid of small multiples.
forms.a11y: Table of correlation coefficients.

forms.name: Heatmap
forms.job: Scan a value across two categorical dimensions
forms.use_when: Time of day by day of week, survey criteria by participant, correlation matrices.
forms.avoid_when: Fewer than about 12 cells (use a table).
forms.limits: Sequential single hue, or diverging around a meaningful center. Always a scale legend. Print the value in cells when they fit.
forms.recharts: Not in Recharts: a CSS grid of divs or custom SVG rects with tokens.
forms.a11y: Cell values in the table view; each cell focusable if interactive.

forms.name: Timeline or Gantt chart
forms.job: Show tasks across a time range
forms.use_when: Project plans with swim lanes, milestones, dependencies.
forms.avoid_when: No scheduling question.
forms.limits: Rows for tasks, bars for duration. Today line, milestones as markers.
forms.recharts: Custom, or a Gantt component from the workspace manifest.
forms.a11y: A list or table of tasks with start and end dates.

forms.name: Funnel (bars with step conversion)
forms.job: Show drop-off through ordered stages
forms.use_when: Conversion, onboarding, checkout, routing.
forms.avoid_when: Stages that aren't strictly sequential.
forms.limits: Aligned bars, one-hue ordinal ramp, step conversion and abandonment between stages, guard counts under the threshold.
forms.recharts: BarChart with Funnel-like layout, or Recharts FunnelChart styled as bars.
forms.a11y: Table with step, count, conversion and abandonment.

forms.name: Sankey diagram
forms.job: Show flows of a conserved quantity between categories
forms.use_when: Money, traffic or users moving between about 15 or fewer nodes.
forms.avoid_when: More than about 15 nodes (use a table); non-conserved flows.
forms.limits: Link width equals quantity. Highlight a path to isolate it.
forms.recharts: Sankey.
forms.a11y: Table of source, target, value.

forms.name: Flowchart
forms.job: Document a process or decision logic
forms.use_when: Steps and yes or no branches.
forms.avoid_when: Quantities.
forms.limits: Diagram, not a chart. Boxes for steps, diamonds for decisions.
forms.recharts: Not a chart: use a diagram component or a figure.
forms.a11y: Ordered list alternative.

forms.name: Network or force-directed graph
forms.job: Show who connects to whom
forms.use_when: Connectivity itself is the question and nodes number under about 100.
forms.avoid_when: Anything a table or bar chart answers.
forms.limits: Cluster by color, size by degree, label the hubs only.
forms.recharts: Custom (d3-force).
forms.a11y: An adjacency table or list.

forms.name: Chord diagram
forms.job: Show pairwise flows among a few groups
forms.use_when: Trade or resource flows among about 12 or fewer groups.
forms.avoid_when: General audience.
forms.limits: Arcs for groups, ribbons for flows.
forms.recharts: Custom (d3-chord).
forms.a11y: Matrix table.

forms.name: Choropleth map
forms.job: Show a rate by region
forms.use_when: Normalized values (per capita, rate) across regions the audience can place.
forms.avoid_when: Raw counts (big regions look important by area alone).
forms.limits: Sequential ramp, scale legend, a ranked bar list beside it.
forms.recharts: Not in Recharts: a map component from the workspace manifest.
forms.a11y: Ranked table of regions.

forms.name: Cartogram
forms.job: Show a value by distorting region size
forms.use_when: The audience knows the geography well and area should equal the value.
forms.avoid_when: Almost always; the distortion becomes unreadable.
forms.limits: Pair with a ranked table.
forms.recharts: Custom.
forms.a11y: Ranked table.
